speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) when will work begin on the installation of smoke and fire alarms for HDB rental flats; (b) which housing estates will be covered in the initial stage; and (c) how long will this exercise take to complete the installation for all rental flats.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: First, the installation, is it for all the rental flats?

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: Previously, it was planned for only those rental flats with senior residents, but I think we should do it for all the rental flats.

speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
text: The second question is: Nee Soon South is under which phase?

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I made the announcement and I had explained then that between HDB and SCDF, they have reached an agreement.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: To the second question, if Er Dr Lee Bee Wah did not ask that question, I would be rather surprised.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: It probably would have been someone else in disguise.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: I would be very happy if Nee Soon South was in the first phase.

speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
text: But if it is not in the first phase, then it would be in the second phase or perhaps in the third phase.

speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Holland-Bukit Timah)
text: I just want to ask the Minister, what about after the rental flats are done, would you consider the studio apartments as well, because it is mostly seniors living there?
